name: Poison Ranged Animate Weapons
summary: Animate Weapon of Ranged Arms turns dropped ranged weapons into a poison firing line: each animated bow keeps shooting while you move, and the Necromancer shell keeps the swarm alive. The build needs no unique, only weapons on the ground and a Necromancer to command them.

pros.text: The animated weapons keep firing while you move and dodge.
Poison keeps ticking after the volley, so damage does not stop.
Damage scales with minion notables and gem levels, not your own gear.
No required unique; the build works from the first dropped bow.
A ranged minion army is safer than a melee summoner.
The same caster gear serves any later Necromancer build.

cons.text: The army needs ranged weapons on the ground before it starts.
Animated weapons expire, and a long boss phase can outlast them.
Poison needs a moment to ramp, so short bursts feel slow.
Minion AI spreads the firing line and can leave a straggler.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a well-geared melee mapper.
Fewer links early means the weapon count matters more than the tooltip.

summary.text: Poison Ranged Animate Weapons measure 75.8k at red maps and 108.1k at pinnacle. The animated bows poison from range while you position, and the build needs no unique.

leveling.text: Level with Summon Skeletons until ranged weapons start dropping, then animate every bow you find. The first checkpoint measures 369 life and 476 damage; the second measures 2.9k.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 75.8k damage, 31110 effective life and 11118 physical max hit. Animate the first pack's bows, then keep the swarm moving with Flesh Offering.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 108.1k damage with 40917 effective life and 13167 physical max hit. Stack the bows before the burst, refresh Flesh Offering, and recast Animate Weapon when the oldest ones expire.
